# pilot release and isolated-capacity plan

Case: CASE-070
Document control number: SPEC-0070
Effective revision: R1
Superseded revision visible in archive: R9
Subject: revised-design pilot build
Primary measure: approved prototype quantity
Source finished or header quantity: 71
Effective usage per finished or header unit: 1 EA
Unit: EA
Eligibility definition: material and fixture coverage at the released pilot revision
Exclusion definition: production stock protected for customer orders
Control: ECO release, prototype scope, lot separation, and start approval

## Applicability

Apply only to NS-000070, organization SEA, and CASE-070. A matching title, filename, supplier, or item description is insufficient without the immutable record and released revision.

## Reconciliation rule

Build the supported measure from the independent observed rows and subtract only rows carrying an effective exclusion reason. Do not use archive, draft, other-case, or other-plant rows in either side of the equation.

## Timing and authority

Internal timing comes from isolated pilot-cell window; external timing is conditional on prototype component readiness. Protected work is not displaceable. Separate approval is required for the escalation path, and a faster date does not waive the control.

## Output control

The system action must preserve the source identity, effective revision, supported measure, and scoped approval. This specification deliberately does not contain a netted result, selected option, or final outcome date.
